F-02

Chimney & stove sweep

OK when done yearly

Flue, smoke shelf, stove pipe and baffle brushed clean, with the soot vacuumed at the source.

Drop cloths go down first. A vacuum runs at the firebox opening the whole time. The brush goes up the flue, the soot comes down into the vacuum, and your hearth is clean when we leave.

Price it
Rods and brush on the roof — the climb that happens before every sweep.
F-03

Home sale camera inspection

OK for closing

A full video scan of the flue for buyers and sellers, with the report sent the same week.

A camera on a rod goes the full length of the flue. You get video of every tile, a written summary, and a clear line saying whether it is safe to use. Most reports go out the same week.

Price a camera inspection

What "watch" means

On our note, OK means it is fine to burn. Watch means it can wait — we write down what to look for and when to recheck. Fix means do not light it until this part is repaired. No pressure, no upsell. If a finding on your note turns out wrong, we come back and fix that part at no charge.
